name: Background app refresh
description: Refreshes data in the background with BackgroundTasks through SwiftUI's backgroundTask scene modifier, rescheduling after each run.
usage: In the App, add `.backgroundTask(.appRefresh(BackgroundRefresh.identifier)) { await BackgroundRefresh.run { try await model.refresh() } }` to the WindowGroup scene, and call `BackgroundRefresh.schedule()` when the app moves to the background (`scenePhase == .background`). The system decides when to run it; never rely on exact timing.
